hero.subtitle: Watch it come together on the right: name your shop, drop in a few products, then send buyers to one link. That's the whole build, start to finish.

flow.title: Three moves, zero guesswork.
flow.subtitle: Tap a step to see exactly what happens. Every move takes minutes, not a manual.

createShop.title: Create your shop
createShop.description: Sign up, name your store, pick your URL. You get a live link you can paste anywhere. No DNS, no deploy, no drama.

addProducts.title: Add your products
addProducts.description: Photos, prices, short descriptions. One catalog you can refine anytime. Buyers see clarity, not chaos.

shareAndSell.title: Share and take orders
shareAndSell.description: Same link in bio, stories, and chats. They browse on the phone. You track everything in your dashboard.

bullets.b1: Put the link in your profile or bio
bullets.b2: Share in chat or social posts

channels.title: You already have buyers here.
channels.subtitle: Stallio doesn't ask people to go somewhere new. It just gives the channels they already use one link that actually sells.

live.title: One storefront, two sides.
live.subtitle: A fast link on the outside. A calm dashboard on the inside. Flip the toggle to see both.

dashboard.label: Your dashboard
dashboard.title: You see control.
dashboard.description: Orders, products, and requests in one view. Update stock between deliveries without opening ten apps.

points.p1: Mark paid, ship, and download invoice PDFs
points.p2: Coupons, delivery, and stock in one place
points.p3: Export orders or add a manual phone order

storefront.label: Their storefront
storefront.title: They see polish.
storefront.description: Categories, cart, coupons, and checkout, built for the phone. Buyers can switch English, Spanish, or Arabic on your store.

points.p1: Cart and checkout in a couple of taps

domain.question: Do I need a domain?
domain.answer: No. Your link lives at stallio.shop/you from the moment you sign up.

editAfter.question: Can I edit after publishing?
editAfter.answer: Anytime. Prices, photos, and stock update on your live link instantly.

noLogo.question: No logo yet?
noLogo.answer: Start with your store name and colors. Add a logo whenever it's ready.

howPay.question: How do buyers pay?
howPay.answer: You set the method, bank, link, or COD. Stallio tracks the order for you.

finalCta.title: Ship the link tonight.
finalCta.subtitle: Free to start. No card on file. If it feels right, keep selling from the same URL tomorrow.
